conventions.units: Rig units (1 unit ~ 4.25 mm at Tibi's 1.75 m); origin at the pelvis joint; soles 190 units below it standing; +x = facing in side view; angles in anatomical degrees (flexion/abduction positive).
conventions.views: front, side (+x), back, top (prone, from above), above (supine, from above)
conventions.accuracy: stylised = on-brand drawing; schematic = structure right, counts illustrative; conceptual-kinematics = authored angles, label illustrative; data = from cited sources
conventions.sculpt: Cobalt Sculpt Tibi (Studio.kit.fitness.sculpt) is the current mascot: male and female, views front, side, back. Rig units: 1 unit = 1/0.54 Cobalt Sculpt units; standing figure about 422 units sole to crown (classic Tibi height); origin at the pelvis joint; same joint ids and anatomical angle signs as the classic Tibi (side: flexion positive, near limbs R; front/back: abduction positive). Master source is the Python generator in src/fitness/tibi/; sculpt-data.js is generated (fitness.py sculpt).

assets.name: Tibi (Cobalt Sculpt) muscle activation
assets.description: Recolours the existing muscle planes by role: 3 prime mover (coral), 2 secondary (marigold), 1 stabiliser (pale cobalt); glutes and hip flexors show over the shorts at level 2+. Named sets for pushup, plank, squat, calf, lateral, flex, run phases and back poses; maps accept sculpt keys or muscles.json ids, with @near/@far.
assets.usage: t.activate(tl, 'squat', at, 0.5); t.muscle('quadriceps') -> callout anchor points
